intro: Bulgaria is known for wrestling, weightlifting, rhythmic gymnastics and one famous World Cup run.

chapters.title: Football
text: Bulgaria finished fourth at the 1994 World Cup, and its star Hristo Stoichkov won the Ballon d'Or that year.

chapters.title: Gymnastics and more
text: Bulgaria's rhythmic gymnastics teams are among the world's best, winning Olympic gold in 2021. Stefka Kostadinova's high jump world record of 2.09 m stood for 37 years, from 1987 to 2024.

keyTerms.meaning: Gymnastics with ribbons, balls, hoops and clubs, set to music.
